content:
Margarida Amândio, AI Researcher of BUILT CoLAB, will be one of the speakers at the virtual conference “Artificial Intelligence in Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AI in AEC) 2021”, which will take place on March 24 and 25.

Margarida Amândio’s intervention is scheduled for March 25, at 2:50 p.m., in the Autonomous Construction panel, where the theme “Artificial Intelligence Based Optimization Of Road Rehabilitation Processes” will be presented, a them that was developed together with Manuel Parente (BUILT CoLAB) and Prof. José Neves (CERIS, IST).

For more information go to the event website here.
